title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 096
review_goal: Differentiate video camera, voice, and wardrobe variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Video camera body with two top circles and one side lens block on the right
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the camera to feel like a classic film body with two circles on top.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the simpler video camera when the top of the body should stay flat without twin circles.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot adds the two top circles that make it read like a classic twin reel camera.

items.depicts_observation: Video camera body with one flat top block and one side lens block on the right
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a simpler camera body without the twin circles of a film style recorder.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the twin reel camera when the top of the body should show two round circles.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot keeps the top of the camera flat instead of adding the two round reel circles.

items.depicts_observation: Five vertical bars centered around one tallest middle bar with shorter bars outside
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the voice cue to read as a balanced centered waveform.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the rising bar voice mark when the bars should climb unevenly from left to right.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot places the tallest bar in the middle and balances the shorter bars around it.

items.depicts_observation: Five vertical bars rising unevenly from left to right with the tallest bar near the right edge
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the voice cue to read like an uneven equalizer that rises across the row.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the centered waveform when the tallest bar should sit in the middle of a balanced pattern.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot climbs toward the right instead of centering the tallest bar in the middle.

items.depicts_observation: Wardrobe body split into two tall doors with one small dot on each door
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the wardrobe to read as two full height cabinet doors.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the mixed wardrobe when one side should break into stacked shelf panels instead of two tall doors.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot is the simpler wardrobe with two equal doors and one dot on each side.
